1479-2841-6528-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6528-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

618-4681-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

475-1274-3263-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1274-3263-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

876-5704-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
876-5704-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Leafkin Avenger.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Leafkin Avenger.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Leafkin Avenger.
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Leafkin Avenger.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Leafkin Avenger.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Leafkin Avenger from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

38-4640-6305--168.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Goblin Samurai, adding {R}.
When the Goblin Samurai dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning the Goblin Samurai from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Oathkeeper's equip ability by paying {1} due to Nahiri, Storm of Stone, attaching it to the Goblin Samurai.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

511-817-4050-4094-7704.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

413-643-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-643-4302.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Blasting Station and Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

465-3742-4251-4452-5434.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

457-1458-4030-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4030-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Starnheim Courser.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-6026-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2292-6026-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Field of Souls and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

5231-7084-7201.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4659-5086-5183-6291-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6291-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2292-3817-4200.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2275-3532-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1247-3918-3980.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sisay's Ring's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2034-2043-6291-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Magic Pot that is a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot token and the Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot token dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1424-1491-2757-6667.description:
Activate Loporrit Scout by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping the basic land.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5147-6663.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4268-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-4268-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Kor Celebrant indestructible.
3490-4050-4268-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

907-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
907-2196-2821-5803.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Selesnya Sanctuary and another land.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

618-1938-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

914-3398-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control a number of artifacts and/or enchantments equal to or greater than seven divided by the number of opponents you have, rounded up.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger or Dockside Extortionist.
Blade of Selves attached to Dockside Extortionist.
914-3398-3851.description:
Declare Dockside Extortionist and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering Hellkite Charger and Dockside Extortionist's myriad ability.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least one token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is tapped and attacking.
When the Dockside Extortionist token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger from step 1, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

579-3493-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Patrol Signaler does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Patrol Signaler.
579-3493-4474.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2474-2773-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to three times Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

2034-2493-2596-4465.notablePrerequisites:
Basal Sliver does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2034-2493-2596-4465.description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards in their graveyards, sacrifice all creatures they control, then put all cards exiled this way onto the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1284-1636-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1284-1636-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, targeting any target.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1737-4404-4772-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Prototype Portal and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

2034-2178-2837-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2178-2837-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Cat or Dog, adding {C}{C}.
The Cat or Dog dies, triggering Black Market Tycoon, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.
